doc: The launch subset's exceptions (p1-launch-readiness design D1), kept by hand: a requirement or acceptance scenario of launch-subset.json that a launch does not prove with a tagged test. after-go-live: moved by the decision it names (a revision of the PRD's history). live-verify: proved in the dev cloud by the evidence it names. covered-elsewhere: proved by the gate it names. make roadmap-check refuses an exception that names nothing of the subset or rests on nothing.
